up: Retrieve the first 200 metabolism records where the enzyme is UGT1A9. For each record, return the substrate structure (canonical SMILES), the substrate compound name, the metabolic conversion description, and the pathway key.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  COALESCE(cr.compound_name, md.pref_name) AS substrate_name,
  m.met_conversion,
  m.pathway_key
FROM metabolism m
JOIN component_synonyms csyn ON csyn.component_synonym = 'UGT1A9'
JOIN component_sequences cseq ON csyn.component_id = cseq.component_id
JOIN compound_records cr ON m.substrate_record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE m.enzyme_tid = csyn.component_id
LIMIT 200;
